name: Jingzhuibing
source:
Noele is a police officer whose biggest monthly expense is neck massages at the therapy parlor. As late autumn sets in, a toy factory strike breaks out, cursed dolls appear in an abandoned tower… and an encounter with her ex-girlfriend completely upends her life. A shady college lecturer, a blind massage therapist, a glamorous businesswoman—who among them is The Flayer?

Through your choices, you’ll shape the story, grow close to different characters, uncover the heroine’s past, and find a path that connects her to others.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4000090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
诺埃勒是一名警察，每月最大的开支是在治疗室进行颈部按摩。深秋来临，玩具厂爆发罢工，被诅咒的娃娃出现在废弃的塔楼里……与前女友的邂逅彻底颠覆了她的生活。一个可疑的大学讲师，一个盲人按摩治疗师，一个迷人的女商人——他们中间谁是剥皮者？

通过你的选择，你将塑造故事，与不同的角色建立亲密关系，揭开女主人公的过去，并找到一条将她与其他人联系起来的道路。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4000090/]Steam[/url]]
